images.name: 한서윤
images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit target is Image 1, the established full-body MASTER of an ADULT office-romance visual novel heroine. Image 2 is ONLY a rendering-style reference. Redraw the ENTIRE figure in Image 2's clear Japanese 2D visual-novel/anime illustration style: clean delicate tapered outlines, crisp but soft cel-shadow shapes, smoothly unified pale warm skin, gentle pink blush, finely drawn almond-shaped eyes with layered glossy irises and restrained lashes, small elegantly simplified nose and mouth, broad clean glossy hair highlights with individually designed strands, consistent 2D clothing folds. This must look recognizably more like Image 2 than the original painterly rendering, but preserve the character identity of Image 1.
LOCK Image 1's hair color, eye color, hairstyle, adult age impression, face identity, full-body proportions, pose, hand positions, outfit design/colors, accessories, shoes and held prop. Do not copy Image 2's blonde hairstyle, hair clip, school uniform, young face proportions, scene, or crop. Maintain a clearly grown adult woman with elegant adult head-to-body proportions and anatomically natural long hands and fingers. Single character, vertical full-length sprite, entire head and both shoes inside canvas with a little margin. Genuine transparent background; no glow/aura, no black backdrop, no checkerboard painted into the image, no floor, no cast shadow, no captions or logos. Match the reference illustration's rendering consistently from face through clothes and feet. No extra characters.
Character invariants: Han Seoyun, adult age 40, the oldest heroine: mature composed almond-shaped brown eyes, chestnut-brown loose low bun, side face-framing locks, berry lipstick and one tiny beauty mark beside the mouth exactly as Image 1. NO earrings; natural smooth ears. Pale-blue buttoned blouse over ivory camisole, open taupe long cardigan, ivory high-waisted slim trousers, black flat loafers with small gold horsebits, silver wristwatch. One hand loosely bent at the waistband, other hand hanging naturally beside the black tablet. Preserve her mature facial character; do not infantilize.
